taskDescription: Drag each word into the correct blank to complete the comparison of the two forms of severe protein–energy malnutrition.
textField: In *marasmus* the child loses subcutaneous fat and muscle, giving an 'old-man' face, while in *kwashiorkor* pitting *oedema* masks the wasting and gives a 'moon face'. The fatty liver in kwashiorkor occurs because the liver cannot export *VLDL* without adequate protein for apolipoprotein synthesis.

overallFeedback.feedback: Marasmus reflects total energy-and-protein deficit with gross wasting, while kwashiorkor reflects disproportionate protein deficit with oedema from low albumin and fatty liver from impaired VLDL assembly — the presence or absence of oedema is the single feature that separates the two on clinical examination.
